title: Chrono Loop Garden
constraints: uses only one interaction type (click OR drag OR type)

workerResult.summary: Chrono Loop Garden: extreme-minimal drag-only generative garden. Drag across soil to plant clock-seeds (row=pitch, col=period/pan), loops auto-evolve every 60s with countdown, drag sideways on a bloom to rewind (past zero uproots), drag-release over the rail exports an 8s OfflineAudioContext WAV chime plus garden code. WebAudio plucks via dub-echo bus, localStorage persistence, 375px+ responsive.
